paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter through nuclear spin precession in electric and magnetic fields
coupling_convention: d_n in e*cm (oscillation amplitude of dn - (mu_n/mu_Hg) d_Hg)
notes: nEDM/UCN-199Hg spin-precession search for oscillating neutron EDM from axion DM. Fig. 2 gives 95% C.L. limits on the oscillation amplitude of dn-(mu_n/mu_Hg)d_Hg (units 10^-26 e cm) vs frequency; values read approximately off the plot and converted freq->mass via m=4.136e-15*f. Baseline ~3-4e-26 e cm. Paper's headline results are on axion-gluon (CG/fa) and axion-nucleon (CN/fa) couplings (Fig. 4); this extraction encodes the directly-measured oscillating EDM amplitude (AxionEDM) per the hint. Could alternatively be encoded as AxionEDM d_n or the gluon coupling; hence moderate confidence.
